storyRegion.meaning: the entire user-drawn yellow Stone Money Island region, not a guessed point

userDirectiveVerbatimOrLosslessSummary: Every report must show, in this order: complete Palau map; unique latest Stone Money Island location; land/beach/reef/channel/deep-ocean structural separation; current workbench screenshot; one sentence naming the most obvious remaining error. Old R01/R03 workbenches and old anchors are forbidden. Land is not reef. High detail only around Airai and the story island.
targetObject: Airai / Stone Money Island geographic truth and workbench delivery sequence
targetDefectOrChange: Stop repeated wrong-frame, wrong-anchor, land-versus-reef conflation and stale-workbench delivery.
precedence: This R09 user directive supersedes the R07 instruction that forbade all structure-separation images.
R09 REQUIRES a structure-separation image, but every layer must be evidence-derived and carry uncertainty/NoData where evidence is insufficient.
R07/R08 remain provenance/history, not authority to skip any R09 required image.
requiredDeliveryOrder: 02 latest unique Stone Money story-region location
allowedEvidence: user original images and their frozen SHA256 identities

structuralLayerRules.land: derived from land/coast/DEM evidence; never expanded to equal reef platform
structuralLayerRules.beach: separate interfacial class only where supported; otherwise UNKNOWN
structuralLayerRules.reef: submerged/shallow reef-platform class from reef/geomorphic/optical/depth evidence; not land
structuralLayerRules.channel: water corridor distinct from reef; must remain topologically continuous through KB Bridge / Toachel Mid
structuralLayerRules.deepOcean: reef-exterior/deeper water class from depth/context evidence
structuralLayerRules.unknown: must remain explicit; never filled for visual completeness

highDetailRule.outsideFocus: retain island existence, coarse placement and basic relations only
highDetailRule.forbidden: same-level high-detail refinement across all islands before focus area passes
